review_scope: Offline native GIF inspection, all frames actually viewed in sequence order as a contact sheet.

pose.observed: Frames 1–3 keep a dropped wrist while lifting the arm. Frame 4 begins opening the hand. Frames 5–7 reach a higher spread palm beside the head. Frames 8–9 lower partway with the palm open. The waist hand and camera stay generally stable.
pose.original_difference: The initial original has a distinct raised thumb, horizontal outer finger and lowered fingers. The original F874 fully straightens the arm into a far steep diagonal. The GIF reaches a steeper, closer-to-head position and then lowers. It uses 0.900s versus the 0.234s native F871–877 segment. Terminal open palm and initial dropped wrist create an observable pose jump across the loop seam.

eyes.observed: Both eyes remain open with low-saturation gray/brown fill and one clear drawn glint per eye across the sampled views. Iris position remains stable across the nine exposures.
eyes.difference: The large lower pale segments have a sharper boundary than the soft lower arc in G33-11 B. The face keeps a slight smile instead of the source’s very small neutral closed mouth.

curl.observed: A consistent single segmented gray ribbon starts at two low red beads on the right of frame. It follows the side of the head and shoulder with subtle pose-to-pose sway and no apparent side switch.
curl.difference: The ribbon is wider and more angular than the reference. It transitions from two large swaths into a very narrow serpentine tip, without the reference’s independently readable small gray return and short inward C. Mint stripes are noticeably prominent. The generated crest uses a hanging black ribbon where the reference has two distinct black leaves.

background_and_style: All nine decoded frames are fully opaque and have a textured pink background. Cleaner linework and a rounder bob differ from G33-11’s hand-drawn silhouette. No project-frame replacement is proposed.
